developmentBacklogAdded.title: Remote travel-burden normalizer
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Distinguish true remote roles from remote roles with occasional mandatory travel. Record travel frequency, destination, duration and whether travel costs/time are compensated, then apply a proportional burden rather than incorrectly treating quarterly travel as regular commuting or ignoring it completely.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Platform ownership scope gate
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Detect roles whose title sounds like support but whose real scope includes platform administration, governance, configuration ownership or managerial accountability for systems such as Salesforce. Penalize these before ranking so support-manager or platform-owner jobs do not outrank realistic L1/L2 support roles.
